answered.sql: SELECT T2.trail_id, T2.difficulty FROM National_Parks AS T1 JOIN National_Parks_Trails AS T3 ON T1.park_id = T3.national_park_id JOIN Trails AS T2 ON T3.trail_id = T2.trail_id GROUP BY T2.trail_id, T2.difficulty HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.park_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM National_Parks)
